irrigation.clay: Reduce frequency but ensure depth. Clay holds water too long.
irrigation.sandy: High frequency, low volume. Sandy soil drains in minutes.
irrigation.loam: Standard schedule. Loam is the ideal balance.
irrigation.black: Deep watering required. Black soil cracks when dry.

pests.flowering: Avoid heavy chemical sprays to protect pollinators.
pests.seedling: Protect tender shoots from aphids and damping-off.
pests.fruiting: Monitor for borers. Use organic traps near harvest.

soil.red: Needs organic matter to improve nutrient retention.
soil.alluvial: Naturally fertile, but needs nitrogen management for high yield.
soil.laterite: Acidic soil. Use lime treatment to balance pH.
